svg.title: 13 deep-draft ports each saw 1,000 or more different large ships within 10 km

cc:Work.dc:title: 13 deep-draft ports each saw 1,000 or more different large ships within 10 km
cc:Work.dc:description: Bubble map of 73 deep-draft ports sized by the number of large ships nearby; the largest circles are on the Texas and Louisiana coast, at Los Angeles-Long Beach, and at New York.
